sources.title: ADXL354/ADXL355 Data Sheet
sources.released_version_or_commit: Rev D; revision history June 2025 (Rev C→D)
sources.observed_operation: Manufacturer datasheet: selectable ±2/±4/±8 g; defaults HPF off, LPF 1000 Hz, ODR 4000 Hz; 0.63 ms digital group delay at 4 kHz; interface ceilings and synchronization/sample continuity described.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Defaults are power-up only and configurable. 400 kHz I2C recommended ODR max 800 Hz; higher rates may miss samples/add noise. Sync modes impose different timing/delay.
sources.applicability: Concrete MEMS alternative demonstrating settings/timing issues; not evidence this is cart logger.

sources.title: Measuring Vibration with Accelerometers
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current HTML; no dated release/commit displayed
sources.locator: Key Takeaways; Choosing the Right Accelerometer; Sensitivity; Weight; Mounting Options; lines 123–248
sources.observed_operation: Vendor technical guide describes range/sensitivity/calibration, triaxial sensing, mass loading, mounting compliance and piezo/IEPE choices.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Mount frequency examples apply to typical 100 mV/g accelerometers; not universal. Stud is best for high frequency but generally permanent; looser mounts/base mass shift usable frequency/resonance.
sources.applicability: General design guidance for bracket/reference comparison; verify chosen sensor/structure.

sources.title: EVAL-ADXL355Z Linux command line for setting the sample frequency
sources.released_version_or_commit: Q&A opened 2023-04-12, verified vendor answer 2023-05-15; EVAL-ADXL355Z, PetaLinux 2022.2/Linux 5.15.36, IIO/SPI 6.25 MHz
sources.locator: setup lines 278–297; support response/interrupt counts lines 346–365
sources.observed_operation: User reported configured 4 kHz but ~2 kHz effective. Vendor reproduced dropped data-ready interrupts on Raspberry Pi and proposed FIFO-full servicing.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Specific non-real-time Linux interrupt path. Vendor said system limitation; FIFO was proposed future work and no shipped fix is confirmed in this thread.
sources.applicability: Audit effective ODR/loss behavior on actual logger; do not generalize to other platform/version.

sources.title: Simultaneous Measurements of the Vehicle, Track, and Soil Vibrations at a Surface, Bridge, and Tunnel Railway Line
sources.released_version_or_commit: 2017 version of record; DOI 10.1155/2017/1959286; field campaign performed 1994
sources.observed_operation: Primary field report: vehicle piezo accelerometers, track/soil geophones, multiple positions, track types, speed-varying passes; 72-channel/2 kHz system on surface line.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Passenger train/fixed measuring-car load and specified high-speed track. Impulse tests were unloaded and lower amplitude than train passages.
sources.applicability: Supports synchronized multi-location references and speed comparisons; no cart thresholds or diagnosis transfer.

sources.title: Assessment of integration method for displacement determination using field accelerometer and geophone data
sources.released_version_or_commit: 2017 version of record; Journal of Zhejiang University SCIENCE A 18(7), 553–566; DOI 10.1631/jzus.A1600212
sources.observed_operation: Primary field study compared accelerometers/geophones at three rail depths and sleeper LVDT; discusses filtering, loading wavelength, repeatability, speed, and axle load.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Specific conventional rail/soil displacement study; reported frequency/speed findings apply to its quantity, train and sensors.
sources.applicability: Supports independent reference and explicit load/speed/filter validity; results do not transfer numerically.

sources.title: Experimental Study of Wheel-to-Rail Interaction Using Acceleration Sensors for Continuous Rail Transport Comfort Evaluation
sources.released_version_or_commit: 2023-09-25 VOR; Sensors 23(19):8064, DOI 10.3390/s23198064; HTML notes updates through 2026-08-27
sources.observed_operation: Primary rail-wagon study uses multiple axle/bogie/body sensor positions and empty/loaded conditions; describes 50 ms/20 Hz recorded interval.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Specified tank wagon/test center/comfort objective; 20 Hz logging cannot establish high-frequency impact capture; current HTML has post-publication updates noted.
sources.applicability: Load and mount-location design precedent only; not a cart diagnostic.

sources.title: Order tracking — Dewesoft X Manual EN
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current online Dewesoft X manual page, no release/date pinned
sources.locator: Overview/hardware notes lines 45–59; angle source setup lines 81–103
sources.observed_operation: Manual requires accelerometer and angle/RPM reference for order tracking; recommends ≥10 kHz in many cases; signal-estimated speed lacks absolute zero-angle phase.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Specific vendor module, not universal sampling rule. Signal tracking estimates RPM and does not supply zero-angle phase.
sources.applicability: Optional wheel-order analysis only; encoder/tach needed if absolute angular phase matters; does not locate cart along track.

sources.title: A methodology for the measurement of track geometry based on computer vision and inertial sensors
sources.observed_operation: Primary methods preprint combines camera/laser, IMU and odometry/GNSS/wheel encoder for track-position/geometry measurement.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Proposed railway system requires rigid installation, calibration, visible rail heads and known ideal geometry; not demonstrated on cart.
sources.applicability: Spatial-reference precedent only; simple surveyed markers/encoder may suffice here.
